name: Spicy Chicken Stir-fry
briefDescription: A quick and flavorful stir-fry with chicken and vegetables. Great for weeknight dinners.
ingredients:
Chicken breast — 200g
Bell peppers — 2
Soy sauce — 2 tbsp
Garlic — 3 cloves
Sesame oil — 1 tsp

name: Avocado Black Bean Tacos
briefDescription: Creamy avocado and hearty black beans wrapped in warm corn tortillas. Ready in 15 minutes.
ingredients:
Corn tortillas — 4
Black beans — 1 can
Avocado — 1
Lime — 1
Cilantro — handful
Cumin — 1 tsp
Salt — to taste
notes: Mash the avocado with lime juice right before serving to prevent browning. Add jalapeño slices for extra heat.

name: Lemon Garlic Salmon
briefDescription: Pan-seared salmon with a bright lemon garlic butter sauce. Elegant enough for guests, easy enough for Tuesday.
ingredients:
Salmon fillets — 2
Butter — 2 tbsp
Garlic — 4 cloves
Lemon — 1
Fresh dill — 1 tbsp
Salt and pepper — to taste
notes: Pat the salmon completely dry before searing for a crispier crust. Do not move the fillet for the first 3 minutes.

name: Overnight Oats with Berries
briefDescription: Creamy no-cook oats prepped the night before, topped with fresh mixed berries.
ingredients:
Rolled oats — 1 cup
Almond milk — 1 cup
Chia seeds — 1 tbsp
Maple syrup — 1 tbsp
Mixed berries — half cup
Vanilla extract — half tsp

name: Greek Chicken Bowl
briefDescription: Marinated grilled chicken over rice with cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and tzatziki.
ingredients:
Chicken thighs — 300g
Cooked rice — 1 cup
Cucumber — half
Cherry tomatoes — 6
Kalamata olives — 8
Tzatziki — 3 tbsp
Olive oil — 1 tbsp
Oregano — 1 tsp
notes: Marinate the chicken overnight in olive oil, lemon, and oregano for the best flavor. Store toppings separately if meal prepping.

name: Vegan Lentil Soup
briefDescription: A hearty, warming red lentil soup with cumin and smoked paprika. Perfect for cold days.
ingredients:
Red lentils — 1 cup
Vegetable broth — 4 cups
Onion — 1
Carrot — 2
Garlic — 3 cloves
Cumin — 1 tsp
Smoked paprika — 1 tsp
Olive oil — 1 tbsp

name: Pesto Zucchini Noodles
briefDescription: Light and fresh zucchini noodles tossed in homemade basil pesto. Low-carb and satisfying.
ingredients:
Zucchini — 3 large
Fresh basil — 2 cups
Parmesan — quarter cup
Pine nuts — 3 tbsp
Garlic — 2 cloves
Olive oil — quarter cup
Salt and pepper — to taste
notes: Salt the zucchini noodles and let them sit for 10 minutes, then pat dry. This removes excess water and prevents a watery dish.

name: Egg Fried Rice
briefDescription: Classic takeout-style fried rice made at home in under 20 minutes using leftover rice.
ingredients:
Cooked white rice — 2 cups
Eggs — 3
Frozen peas and carrots — half cup
Soy sauce — 2 tbsp
Sesame oil — 1 tsp
Green onions — 3
Garlic — 2 cloves
Vegetable oil — 2 tbsp

name: Turkey and Spinach Stuffed Peppers
briefDescription: Bell peppers filled with seasoned ground turkey, spinach, and melted mozzarella.
ingredients:
Bell peppers — 4
Ground turkey — 400g
Fresh spinach — 2 cups
Mozzarella — half cup
Diced tomatoes — 1 can
Garlic — 3 cloves
Italian seasoning — 1 tsp
Salt and pepper — to taste
notes: Blanch the peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes before stuffing so they soften evenly in the oven. Cover with foil for the first 20 minutes of baking.

name: Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie
briefDescription: A thick and creamy high-protein smoothie perfect as a post-workout meal or quick breakfast.
ingredients:
Banana — 1 frozen
Peanut butter — 2 tbsp
Greek yogurt — half cup
Almond milk — 1 cup
Honey — 1 tsp
Protein powder — 1 scoop (optional)

name: Shrimp and Mango Salad
briefDescription: A refreshing tropical salad with grilled shrimp, fresh mango, avocado, and a lime dressing.
ingredients:
Shrimp — 200g
Mango — 1
Avocado — 1
Mixed greens — 2 cups
Red onion — quarter
Lime juice — 2 tbsp
Olive oil — 1 tbsp
Chili flakes — pinch
notes: Grill the shrimp with a little chili and lime zest for extra flavor. Use ripe but firm mango so it holds its shape in the salad.

name: Butternut Squash Curry
briefDescription: A creamy coconut milk curry with tender butternut squash and warming spices. Serve over basmati rice.
ingredients:
Butternut squash — 400g
Coconut milk — 1 can
Onion — 1
Garlic — 3 cloves
Ginger — 1 tsp
Curry powder — 2 tsp
Garam masala — 1 tsp
Vegetable broth — half cup
Olive oil — 1 tbsp
Fresh cilantro — to serve
notes: Roast the squash cubes at 400°F for 15 minutes before adding to the curry for a deeper, caramelized flavor. The curry thickens considerably as it sits overnight.

name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
briefDescription: A classic French composed salad with tuna, green beans, hard-boiled eggs, and a Dijon vinaigrette.
ingredients:
Canned tuna — 2 cans
Green beans — 1 cup
Eggs — 3
Cherry tomatoes — 8
Kalamata olives — 10
Red potatoes — 2
Dijon mustard — 1 tsp
Red wine vinegar — 2 tbsp
Olive oil — 3 tbsp
Salt and pepper — to taste
notes: Cook the potatoes and green beans ahead of time and chill them. Dress each component separately so nothing gets soggy.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Burrito
briefDescription: Hearty roasted sweet potato and black beans wrapped in a flour tortilla with chipotle sauce.
ingredients:
Sweet potato — 1 large
Black beans — 1 can
Flour tortillas — 2 large
Chipotle sauce — 2 tbsp
Shredded cheese — quarter cup
Lettuce — handful
Sour cream — 2 tbsp
Cumin — 1 tsp
Olive oil — 1 tbsp
photoFullFilename: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Burrito

name: Miso Glazed Cod
briefDescription: Tender cod fillets marinated in a sweet white miso glaze and broiled until caramelized.
ingredients:
Cod fillets — 2
White miso paste — 3 tbsp
Mirin — 2 tbsp
Sake or dry sherry — 1 tbsp
Sugar — 1 tsp
Sesame seeds — 1 tsp
Green onions — to serve
notes: Marinate the cod for at least 2 hours, or overnight for best results. Watch closely under the broiler as the miso sugar glaze can burn quickly.

name: Caprese Pasta
briefDescription: Simple summer pasta with fresh mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
ingredients:
Penne pasta — 2 cups
Fresh mozzarella — 150g
Cherry tomatoes — 1 cup
Fresh basil — large handful
Balsamic glaze — 2 tbsp
Olive oil — 2 tbsp
Garlic — 2 cloves
Salt and pepper — to taste

name: Korean Beef Bibimbap
briefDescription: A colorful Korean rice bowl topped with seasoned ground beef, sautéed vegetables, a fried egg, and gochujang.
ingredients:
Cooked white rice — 2 cups
Ground beef — 250g
Spinach — 1 cup
Carrot — 1
Zucchini — 1
Eggs — 2
Gochujang — 2 tbsp
Soy sauce — 2 tbsp
Sesame oil — 1 tsp
Garlic — 2 cloves
Sugar — 1 tsp
notes: Use a hot cast iron skillet to get the crispy rice bottom known as nurungji. Place all toppings in separate sections for the traditional presentation before mixing.

name: Chia Seed Pudding with Mango
briefDescription: A silky, no-cook chia pudding layered with fresh mango puree. Prep it the night before for an effortless breakfast.
ingredients:
Chia seeds — quarter cup
Coconut milk — 1 cup
Maple syrup — 1 tbsp
Vanilla extract — half tsp
Mango — 1 large
Lime juice — 1 tsp
Toasted coconut flakes — 1 tbsp
